### Summary of Changes
- **`ShapeIndex.Encode` and `ShapeIndex.Decode`** ([s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-abxdz_ko/s2/shapeindex.go#L1559-L2147)):
  - Calls `s.Build()` before encoding so unbuilt indexes serialize their complete spatial index state, and marks decoded indexes as `fresh` so queries and iterators work immediately without calling `Build()`.
  - Serializes `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, shape entries (preserving removed/nil shape slots so shape IDs and cell references remain intact), and the ordered spatial cell structure (`cells`, `cellMap`, `ShapeIndexCell`, and `clippedShape` entries).
  - Supports round-trip serialization for all built-in `Shape` types (`Polygon`, `Polyline`, `PointVector`, `LaxPolyline`, `LaxPolygon`, `Loop`, `LaxLoop`, and generic edge/chain shapes), including zero-edge shapes and mixed chain counts.
  - Validates versions, bounds, cell IDs, shape/edge references, ordering invariants, and allocation sizes to return errors rather than panicking on truncated, corrupted, or oversized inputs.
- **Shape & Iterator Fixes**:
  - Fixed `nextID` iteration bounds in [`ShapeIndex.applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-abxdz_ko/s2/shapeindex.go#L849-L860), [`ShapeIndex.makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-abxdz_ko/s2/shapeindex.go#L1214), and [`EdgeIterator`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-abxdz_ko/s2/shapeutil_edge_iterator.go#L54-L61) when shapes have been removed.

- **Tests** ([s2/shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-abxdz_ko/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L576-L944)):
  - Added unit tests and fuzz tests covering empty indexes, unbuilt indexes, all built-in shape types, preserved shape IDs with gaps, writer errors, and malformed/truncated/corrupted inputs.
